about: The sheet-name and scale answer key (D-843): each sheet's number, title and main drawing scale as printed, read from the sheet by eye. scale: the main drawing's, as printed; NTS when nothing on the sheet is drawn to scale. title null: the sheet prints none (a plat's sheets). Sheets from throwaway copies in the bench's 'zz Sheet key' workspace; drives/sheet-key.py fetches them.
